criteria.text: A docs index provides stable navigation; current architecture, module/dependency map, runtime/data/publishing flows, Prisma domain map, provider and Temporal boundaries, local development/verification, and operations/configuration are documented from repository evidence; target Content Factory ownership and migration seams are explicit; documentation maintenance rules and ADR conventions are recorded; a local Graphify code graph is configured, generated, ignored from Git, and used for focused validation; no Content Factory implementation code is copied.
